notes.title: Hey Managers – Time to Start Your Supercar Collection! 🏁
notes.content:
👋 Hello managers,

[b]While you're keeping your clothing empire running strong, we’ve got some exciting news — our brand-new game, Supercar Collection Simulator, is out now with 9 Unique Release Exclusive Vintage Cars! 🚗💨[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/245a1ba346be862c194bc5c5f0b87eac6196c5c2.jpg[/img]

This is not just a sneak peek, it’s the real deal. A deeper, more polished, and much bigger experience awaits.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453600/Supercar_Collection_Simulator/

[h3][b]What you are going to find in release:[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]🕰️ Limited-Time Classics[/b][/h3]
To celebrate the launch, 9 vintage supercars are available to add to your collection — but only for 3 days! After that, you'll have to chase them down in races to add them to your collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c2c7152f78a5a080b16796aafeb4318ddad49e0e.png[/img]

[h3][b]🃏 Skill Card Packs[/b][/h3]
Open packs, build your strategy, and activate unique abilities mid-race to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/a4180f1b5ecf807faeb8f87f22598ce584894029.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🔧 Build and customize your dream garage[/b][/h3]
Design your perfect space, organize your collection, and make it your own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/93d60dfe44583d0540ef5bc7f4a47d62dddfde42.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🏎️ Race your customers[/b][/h3]
Go head-to-head with other collectors in competitive, quick-fire races.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/7a074706b383ad4cfcd176a097688749be801b60.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🃏 Multiplayer Trade Battles[/b][/h3]
Challenge your Steam friends, snatch their best cards, and expand your legendary lineup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/c53a5f73445b7f70e21a740373ee3b33f55e56b0.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🔍 Hunt down rare and legendary supercars[/b][/h3]
Open packs, scout the market, and track down the rarest cars from around the globe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/2ccb74485a6d3027543e37a2185417d6bfe5f2ee.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🪧 Name Your Store [/b][/h3]
Your brand, your legacy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/93d60dfe44583d0540ef5bc7f4a47d62dddfde42.gif[/img]

[h3][b]👥 And that’s just launch day.[/b][/h3]
We’re only getting started; new features, updates, events, and secret drops are coming throughout Early Access. And your feedback is what will shape this world.

[b]👉 Play now. Build your collection. Let the collection passion begin![/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/58bd0d5ff8eb0ccd34e2c2479845ceedb159c8e8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 📢 BREAKING NEWS 📢
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/d780b15ee410a9a9bc6556f60e1ee02257699d00.png[/img]

Unbox surprises, expand your collection, and participate in exciting races on racing platforms. A world of speed awaits you in your store!

[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/e99aab55184104327d33a2da250ba4c22c8b9a7f.gif[/img]

🃏 Attract more customers by upgrading your store! Gain new customers and increase your earnings with new shelves, racing platforms, Supercar boxes, and collections.

notes.title: Clothing Store Simulator: Early Access - Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Attention, managers![/h2]

[h1]Clothing Store Simulator: Early Access is available right now![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/a30cb6187600a3b7b4e2d9a4fb8d1cb864809bd1.png[/img]

[h1]Buy here:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923390/Clothing_Store_Simulator/

[h3]Take control of your own clothing store: manage the prices, design your own product, sign contracts with brands, hire workers, deal with rude customers, and grow your small shop into a giant fashion boutique!
Do you have what it takes? [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/05c3f14ada708dc1af066cce1d191b6c96597702.png[/img]

An here's a list of new features and fixed bugs from the Prologue version of the game: 

[h3]Changes & Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Your progress from the game's Prologue version will be transferred to the full version![/u][/b]
[*] Now you can change the name of your shop!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/225a134c110d08a947284c4e088529f1fb364d85.gif[/img]
[*] Now you can hire Cashiers for your store! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/fa313a522a692840925deba51bf42414389d583e.gif[/img]
[*] Now you can paint your store's walls and floor! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/8d95ccc3917fa47ab80da8bd3b59908e8ea2918c.gif[/img]
[*] Now you can sell shoes, hats, and much more new clothing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/fce92c75f453953d9554c095a8044f0875c3880e.gif[/img]
[*] Now you can customize your store's shopping bag!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/c5ce3ba5e15f497219c96dd425c02f425ca02e02.gif[/img]
[*] Now you can use and move the trash can to pick up trash from your store!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/652142b8081fffe1956000f843a738a672899f9f.gif[/img]
[*] We've updated and added the Warehouse system!
[*] We've increased the number of slots in the Design Workshop since you all love this feature so much!
[*] We've added the Rent and Bills system to bring more realism into the game. 
[*] We've added more customer randomization - get ready to meet new friends! 
[*] Now you can hold LMB to put/take clothes on/from shelves and hangers!  
[*] Now you can purchase a speaker system to fill your store with music!
[*] Now you can use advertisements to bring more customers into your store!
[*] Now you can use Arrow Keys instead of WASD to move around. 
[*] We've added Day and Night cycle 
[*] And we added a news section to the game's menu, so you don't miss any important updates! 
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimization and minor bug fixes
[*] They spin now? They don't! We've fixed the issue with customers spinning on the shopping floor randomly.
[*] We fixed bugs with customers throwing clothes through objects, which made it pretty hard to get them back on the shelves
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png[/img]

And that's not all! Our team is also working on these features that will be added to the game in the next updates: 

[list]
[*] More types of clothes!
[*]  Store workers that will help you organize and stock the store!
[*] NPC Customers will wear your designs!
[*] ... and so much more!
[/list]

Don't forget to join Discord to leave your suggestions and feedback, and talk directly to the team!
[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Listening to your Feedback
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, managers! [/h2]

We want to thank you all for playing Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue, leaving your feedback, and catching bugs!

[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png[/img][/url]

To show you that your feedback is being listened to, we wanted to share a list of some of the changes that we have already made in the Full Version of the game: 

[list]
[*] We fixed bugs with customers throwing clothes through objects!
[*] We've updated and added the Warehouse system!
[*] We've increased the number of slots in the Design Workshop since you all love this feature so much!
[*] We've added the Rent and Bills system to bring more realism into the game. 
[*] They spin now? They don't! We've fixed the issue with customers spinning on the shopping floor randomly.'
[*] We've added more customer randomization - get ready to make new friends! 
[*] You'll be able to hold LMB to put/take clothes on/from shelves and hangers!  
[*] You'll be able to change the name of your shop!
[*] You'll be able to sell shoes, hats, and a lot more new clothing!
[*] You'll be able to paint your store's walls and floor! 
[*] You'll be able to purchase a speaker system to fill your store with music!
[*] You'll be able to hire Cashiers for your store! 
[*] You'll be able to customize your store's shopping bag! 
[*] You'll be able to use advertisements to bring more customers into your store!
[*] You'll be able to use and move the trash can to pick up trash from your store!
[*] You'll be able to use Arrow Keys instead of WASD to move around. 
[*] We've added Day and Night cycle 
[*] And we added a news section to the game's menu, so you don't miss any important updates! 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png[/img]

[h2]And here's some news for you... [/h2]

[h1]Clothing Store Simulator has joined Steam Next Fest! [/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923390/Clothing_Store_Simulator/

[h2]You can wishlist the game, play the Demo, and watch the livestream to see some of the mechanics that will be available in the full game! 

Thank you for your support and helping us make the game even better![/h2]

notes.title: Store Manager Training #2
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, aspiring managers![/h1]

Most of you are already honing your skills in [i]Clothing Store SImulator: Prologue[/i], so today, we wanted to prepare for some of the things that will come in the full version of [i]Clothing Store Simulator[/i]! 

[b]WARNING:[/b] If you read this far and didn’t play [i]Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue[/i] or wishlist the full version, you won’t have the required skills to fully grasp the contents of this training and unlock your full potential as a store manager!* 

[h3]Play now: [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2937710/Clothing_Store_Simulator_Prologue/

[h3]Wishlist now: [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923390/Clothing_Store_Simulator/

[b]And now we're ready to start! [/b]

[i]*For legal reasons we must say this this statement is simply untrue,[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png[/img]

[h2]Become Fashion[/h2]
Being a Clothing Store Manager is great, of course. That’s why we have these trainings! But what if you could not only sell someone else's clothes but… [b]DESIGN YOUR OWN???[/b] Oh yeah, we’re going to make fashion trendsetters out of you! Because every store manager is a multi-faceted being capable of many things! We’ll cover this feature fully in one of our future trainings, so now just get excited and take a look at this highlight: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/1e239f14beee95c62ce8840ea7337c22bf118aed.gif[/img]

[h2]Dressing from Head to Toe[/h2]

[h3]Take a look at these mannequins. What do you notice? [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/849271d8cce258e04fc5b919393bee516dca8924.png[/img]

That’s right! Their head and feet are [i][b]COMPLETELY NAKED[/b][/i]. We want to dress our customers from head to toe, so you'll be able to do that in the full version of the game! Literally! Take a look at some of the hats and shoes that will be available in the game! Aren’t they nice? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/fce92c75f453953d9554c095a8044f0875c3880e.gif[/img]

[h2]Finding Your Personal Touch[/h2]
When customers see your smiling face after entering your store, they know they’re in good hands. But what if they don’t enter and just look from the outside? That’s where further customization comes in! In Clothing Store Simulator, you’ll be able to name your shop and customize your floors and walls. We already know you are thinking of a thousand wholesome and light-hearted names for your stores!

[I](Just please, don’t put them in the comments!)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/225a134c110d08a947284c4e088529f1fb364d85.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/8d95ccc3917fa47ab80da8bd3b59908e8ea2918c.gif[/img]

[h2]Delegate and relegate[/h2]
And finally, what’s better than giving your job to someone else and supervising them instead of doing the busy work yourself? You’ll be able to hire workers for your store, which can be especially handy when your store grows and you need more than two hands to manage everything! Just take a look at your potential workers! Just imagine them in your place and feel a sense of deep relief! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/fa313a522a692840925deba51bf42414389d583e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/05c3f14ada708dc1af066cce1d191b6c96597702.png[/img]

[h3]And that's not everything that will be available in the full version of [i]Clothing Store Simulator[/i]! [/h3]

We will cover more features, customization options, and clothes in our future manager trainings! 

If you want to meet other up-and-coming clothing store managers like yourself, why don’t you join our Discord server? There, you can chat about clothes, stores, and everything in between. 
[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png[/img][/url]

Have fun playing Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue, and don’t forget to wishlist the full game. Wait a minute… I think someone’s trying to steal a shirt! I need to grab him! See you next time!

notes.title: Design Workshop Preview + Release Date announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, shoppers! [/h2]

Today we're releasing a patch for Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue [i](as seen on the main page of Steam)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c9b8991852f41e8e241e9cc0da213f4a1283c07f.png[/img]

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]

We've received a great response to the 'Design Your Own Clothes' feature coming in the full version of [i]Clothing Store SImulator[/i], so as a thank you, [b]we've added a preview of the Design Workshop to the Prologue![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/e2f9029165e8395ab3037d535fd462e8c1d95692.png[/img]

In the Prologue, you can make 1 piece of clothing with your own design, so let your imagination fly! 

[h3]Other Changes & Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] You can now interact with the 'Open/Close' sign from inside the Store;
[*] Fixed an issue where clothes were displayed incorrectly on the mannequins after being purchased.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/05c3f14ada708dc1af066cce1d191b6c96597702.png[/img]

And now for something completely different! We're ready to announce the release date of Clothing Store Simulator: Early Access! 

[h3]The full game will be available on June 17th! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/4198d8bdc6d09b905f81ecfa21951c060aeb6f79.png[/img]

Wishlist now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923390/Clothing_Store_Simulator/

notes.title: Clothing Store Simulator is Coming Soon! Wishlist now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=theR_AjHC5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Get ready to test your clothing store management skills for free in Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue!

Wishlist now! [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2937710/Clothing_Store_Simulator_Prologue/

[h2]Why stop at Prologue? Wishlist Clothing Store Simulator too! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/7eaaa7785c464a0ba84ef644ce8dedd2df20c2eb.gif[/img]
